sentences.text:
The petitioner challenges Ext.P8, an order reversing Ext.P4, passed by the Assistant Collector,
Thiruvananthapuram, directing the restoration of the lands belonging to the petitioners, who belong to the Scheduled Tribes community.

2. The Assistant Collector had found in Ext.P4 that the transfers were invalid going by the Kerala Scheduled Tribes (Restriction on transfer of land and restoration of alienated lands) Act, 1975 and directed the counter petitioners therein to deliver the possession of 13 acres of land to the applicants within 30 days as it was found that the tribal community, the ancestors of the petitioners were in possession of those properties.

entities.text: Kerala Scheduled Tribes (Restriction on transfer of land and restoration of alienated lands) Act, 1975
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2025:KER:9143 WP(C) NO. 39626 OF 2017 3. Ext.P4 order passed by the Assistant Collector was set aside by the Revenue Divisional Officer through Ext.P5, which was challenged by the petitioner in WP(C) No.21968 of 2011.

This Court by its judgment dated 12th January 2016 set aside the order impugned in the Writ Petition and remitted the matter to the 2nd respondent, District Collector for fresh consideration and pass orders after hearing all the affected parties including the petitioners and the respondents therein.

The order so passed is Ext.P8.
4.
The specific contention of the writ petitioner is that the hearing as directed by this Court was done by the Deputy Collector and orders were passed by the District Collector.
In view of the above contentions, this Court passed the following orders on 30.05.2024.
"It is submitted that the person who heard the matter has not passed Ext.P8 order.
The Government Pleader will get instructions.

The Government Pleader will also get instructions as to whether any remedy is there to the 2025:KER:9143 WP(C) NO.
39626 OF 2017 petitioner against Ext.P8"
5.
On verification of the file, it is seen that all statutory notices were issue to the parties in time and hearing was conducted by Deputy Collector (LR).

Several hearing were conducted in this matter by the Deputy Collector (LR) and finally the proceedings have been issued by the District Collector vide B18 -15306/2016 dated 12.06.2017, after perusing the hearing notes and documents thoroughly.

It is here by informed that the proceedings have been issued after examining all the facts regarding the matter."

3 6.

sentences.text: In view of the above, it is clear that the hearing was conducted by the Deputy Collector, which was not as directed by this Court in Ext.P6 judgment.
On the short ground that the order was passed in violation of the directions issued by this Court, Ext.P8 is quashed.

7. There will be a direction to the 3rd respondent District Collector, Thiruvananthapuram to re-hear the appeal filed against Ext.P5 as directed in Ext.P6 judgment, after affording an opportunity 2025:KER:9143 WP(C) NO. 39626 OF 2017 of hearing to all the affected parties, including the petitioners and party respondents 4 to 8.
The decision as directed above shall be taken within three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
It is made clear that the all the contentions of the parties are left open.
The Writ Petition is allowed as above.

SD/-
